name: 34211 · Bradenton, FL
findings: ZIP 34211 (Bradenton) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34211 (Bradenton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34211 (Bradenton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
